_comment: Skill-vocab chunk 3 smoke content (HoT case 1): a healing AURA whose heal-over-time lingers on allies after they leave range. The buff duration (hotTicks*hotTickInterval) outlasts the aura re-apply cadence (tickInterval), so walking out keeps the HoT ticking. Unlike heal_aura this is NOT wounded-only — it pre-hots unhurt allies and keeps refreshing in range (backlog §33, PO 2026-07-31); a tick on a full-HP target is inert, not wasted. Live source: OrcWarlord rare re-farm drop at 0.25 (C8 drop-rate pass, PO 2026-07-20; raised 0.1 -> 0.25 in playtest-1 Pass A - this comment said 0.1 until 2026-07-31, the mob JSON is authoritative).
